maria-pm: Quick check-in — proposing a phased geo-eviction plan for model routing when capacity or regional saturation hits. Goals: preserve p95 latency SLO, avoid flapping, and give clear opt-outs for VIPs. Sketch below.

anna-prod: +1. Need definitions for 'eviction' actions. My suggestion: soft-shed (reduce tokens / shorter context), fallback-variant (smaller model), hard-cut (route to hosted-safe).

maria-pm: Agreed. Proposal (high level):
- phase 0: shadow-only detection (no user impact)
- phase 1: soft-shed to quantized-variant (feature flag = `geo_eviction_mode=soft`)
- phase 2: regional fallback to small-model variant (flag -> `geo_eviction_mode=hard`)
- phase 3: global safe-model fallback if regional controls fail

raj_sre: Telemetry reqs: per-region and per-customer p95 + error-rate. Automatic rollback trigger: error_rate > 2% OR p95 increase > 150ms for 3 consecutive minutes. Also track evictions/sec and recovery time.

sophie-engplatform: Flag and rollout knobs (draft):
```
# example
geo_eviction_mode: off | shadow | soft | hard
geo_eviction_slice_pct: 0-100
geo_eviction_exempt_customers: [customer_ids]
eviction_cooldown_s: 600
max_evictions_per_hour: 5
```
We should keep flags at region granularity (eu-west, us-east, ap-south).

ben-custops: Heads-up from customer ops — Customer X asked for a strict non-eviction SLA during business hours in EU. They want explicit opt-out and an economic discussion if we keep capacity reserved.

maria-pm: For VIPs we can add `customer_tag: eviction_exempt`. That will route them to dedicated capacity or skip soft-shedding. Need pricing/legal approval. Product decision: is opt-out a must-have or paid add-on?

raj_sre: Ops checklist before rolling: preflight smoke tests for each model variant, canary shadow validation, circuit-breaker settings (eviction_cooldown = 600s), and runbook entries for manual override. Also recommend a k8s-side token-bucket to limit evictions within a minute to avoid cascading.

sophie-engplatform: Canary plan suggestion: start with 2% EU traffic (15m window) -> 10% (30m) -> 25% (1h). Always run shadow sampling against main model to measure quality delta (BLEU/ROUGE-ish signals or customer-specific eval). If quality delta > acceptable threshold -> halt. Include automatic snapshotting of prompts that experienced evictions for debugging.

anna-prod: Launch criteria (must-haves):
- 0 customer-visible regressions in 48h on canary cohort
- p95 latency delta < 50ms vs baseline
- failover success in test harness 100% for 3 consecutive runs
- docs & comms: rollback play and customer opt-out API published

maria-pm: Next steps: I'll open the feature ticket (PRD + runbook stub) and ping @legal and @sales for VIP pricing and SLA language. Ops: can you validate the circuit-breaker thresholds?

ben-custops: Please add a customer comms template for planned eviction windows + an emergency rollback comms. Also add a quick API for toggling `eviction_exempt` per tenant. :pray:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `rollout/geo-evict/v1` -> canary start 2026-03-26T09:00:00Z (2% eu-west)

sophie-engplatform: I'll draft the runbook, flag docs, and the telemetry dashboard queries. Adding shadow eval pipeline to the canary job. Anything else urgent?

maria-pm: Thanks — want to reconvene after runbook + legal reply. If anyone has additional must-haves, drop them here and I'll fold into the ticket.
